# AF3 dftracer Pipeline — Final Report Reproduction Package

This folder is a **self-contained** deliverable for the AF3 (AlphaFold3)
MSA-scaling diagnosis + XLA bucket-alignment optimization session
(`af3/20260729_044330`). You need NOTHING outside this folder to reproduce
the reported numbers.

## 1. Copy this folder and set the one real path

```bash
cp -r final_report/ /somewhere/af3_report_check/
cd /somewhere/af3_report_check/
```

Edit `config.ini` and set:

```
WORKSPACE_ROOT=/somewhere/af3_report_check
```

`config.ini` is the ONLY file in this package where a real path/session
value goes. Every script under `scripts/` sources `scripts/lib_load_config.sh`,
which reads `config.ini` — none of them hardcode a workspace path, username,
or allocation id.

## 2. Install (rebuild the AF3 venv + dftracer)

```bash
bash scripts/install.sh
```

This rebuilds the AF3 venv (ROCm jaxlib/jax_rocm60 wheels, `build_data`,
pinned pandas/numpy, the `jax_triton/__init__.py` ROCm patch) and installs
`pydftracer` into the same venv, per the exact recipe in `REPORT.md` §3
(dftracer-build-app / dftracer-build-dftracer). Some steps (wheel URLs,
`build_data` entry point) print a reminder to fill in a site-specific detail
rather than guessing — this is intentional, not a bug.

## 3. Run everything

```bash
bash scripts/run_all.sh <alloc-id>
```

`<alloc-id>` is a Flux allocation/job id on a system with the same module
stack (Tuolumne: AMD MI300A, ROCm 6.0.0, Cray PE). `run_all.sh` drives, in
order:
- `run_baseline_1eby.sh` / `run_baseline_1e66.sh` (each called twice, for the
  primary run and its `_r2` replicate) — the two-scale baseline that
  established the noise band in `REPORT.md` §2.
- `run_compute_opt1.sh` (called once per variant: `control`, `triton`,
  `autotune`, `tightbucket`, `jitcache`) — the compute-dimension 1eby
  variants from `REPORT.md` §7 rows 3-6.
- `run_opt_memory_noprealloc.sh` (called 3x per side) — the memory-dimension
  1eby A/B (`XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false`), `REPORT.md` §7 row 2.
- `run_verify_1e66_bucket1088.sh` — the decisive bucket-alignment
  verification run, `REPORT.md` §7 row 1 (the headline -27% result).
- `run_verify_1e66_noprealloc.sh` — the memory-win transfer check at 1e66,
  `REPORT.md` §7 row 2's negative result.

`run_env_af3.sh` is a shared helper (module loads, venv activation,
`XLA_FLAGS`, dftracer's required Cray CCE `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`) sourced by every
`run_*` script above — you don't call it directly.

Each script prints its own wall time to stdout; redirect to your own log
file if you want it saved (e.g. `bash scripts/run_all.sh <alloc-id> 2>&1 |
tee artifacts/run_all.log`).

`scripts/render_pdf.sh` regenerates `REPORT.pdf` from `REPORT.md` standalone
(pandoc if present, else a pure-Python fallback) — run it any time after
editing `REPORT.md`; it needs no other script in this folder.

`scripts/readme_smoke_test.sh` is a static check that this README names
every script and gives a runnable command — re-run it after editing this
file.

## 4. How to tell it worked

Compare your reproduced wall times against `REPORT.md` §7 (Optimization
Ledger) and §7b (N-Way Comparator Table):
- `baseline_1e66` / `_r2` should land in the 1077-1097s range.
- `verify_1e66_bucket1088` should land near 793s (well below the baseline
  range — this is the headline -27% result; "within noise" here means
  within ~2-3% of 793s, since the baseline's own replicate spread is ~2%).
- `verify_1e66_noprealloc` should land near or slightly above the baseline
  range (1109s reported) — this is the expected "does not transfer" result,
  not a bug if your number is similarly close to baseline.
- 1eby compute/memory variants should reproduce the no-op / -4.9% patterns
  in §7 Table A/B.

## 5. What's in `scripts/`

| Script | Does |
|---|---|
| `lib_load_config.sh` | Sourced by every other script; loads `config.ini`, validates `WORKSPACE_ROOT` |
| `run_env_af3.sh` | Shared helper: module loads, venv activation, `XLA_FLAGS`, dftracer LD_LIBRARY_PATH — sourced by every `run_*` script, never called directly |
| `install.sh` | Rebuilds AF3 venv + installs dftracer |
| `run_baseline_1eby.sh` | 1eby baseline (pass a run-name arg for the `_r2` replicate) |
| `run_baseline_1e66.sh` | 1e66 baseline (pass a run-name arg for the `_r2` replicate) |
| `run_compute_opt1.sh` | Compute-dimension 1eby variant (arg: `control\|triton\|autotune\|tightbucket\|jitcache`) |
| `run_opt_memory_noprealloc.sh` | Memory A/B at 1eby (args: replicate tag, `ctrl\|noprealloc`) |
| `run_verify_1e66_bucket1088.sh` | Decisive bucket-alignment verification at 1e66 |
| `run_verify_1e66_noprealloc.sh` | Memory-win transfer check at 1e66 |
| `run_all.sh` | Runs all of the above in order |
| `run_proxy_validate_bucket1088.sh` | Thin wrapper used for the actual GPU-allocation self-contained validation of this package (loads `config.ini`, then calls `run_verify_1e66_bucket1088.sh`) — a template for launching any `run_*.sh` script under `flux proxy <alloc> flux run -N1 --exclusive <this wrapper>` rather than inlining module loads in the proxy invocation |
| `render_pdf.sh` | Regenerates `REPORT.pdf` from `REPORT.md` standalone |
| `readme_smoke_test.sh` | Static check that this README is complete |

**Validation status:** this package was validated end-to-end on a real GPU
allocation (see `REPORT.md` for the reproduced number) — `run_verify_1e66_bucket1088.sh`
was executed standalone via `run_proxy_validate_bucket1088.sh`, using only this
folder's `config.ini`/`scripts/`, with `OUTPUT_ROOT` pointed at a scratch
directory isolated from the original session's own run data.

See `REPORT.md` for the full narrative, every measured number, and the
complete optimization ledger.
